simple.meaning: גֹּפֶר (gôpher) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Genesis, beginning at Genesis 6:14. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֹּפֶר (H1613).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גֹּפֶר (gôpher) / H1613 is traced through Genesis 6:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress
definitions.full: H1613. gopher גֹּ֫פֶר noun [masculine] gopher , only in עֲצֵיגֹּֿפֶר Gen 6:14 (P), wood of which the ark was made (word dubious; Thes compare כֹּפֶר & so Rob Ges (hence ' pitch-wood , resinous wood'), compare Di; Lag Semitica i. 64 ; Symmict. ii. 93, BN 217 ff. thinks word not original, but inferred from גפרית , and substituted here for גפרית by copyist, or editor. compare following).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in;

occurrences.englishText: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
